  • Class
    Description
    Agent
    Core interface that every agent in the computational graph must implement.
    BinOpAgent
    Generic binary-operation agent that subscribes to two input topics, applies a configurable BinaryOperator to their values, and publishes the result to one output topic.
    Config
    Lifecycle interface for a configuration that builds and manages a set of agents.
    DivAgent
    Agent that divides the first input value by the second and publishes the quotient.
    GenericConfig
    File-based implementation of Config that instantiates agents reflectively from a plain-text configuration file.
    Graph
    Directed graph of the current computational pipeline, stored as a list of Nodes.
    IncAgent
    Agent that increments a single input value by 1 and publishes the result.

    Message
    Immutable value object that carries a single piece of data through the topic system.
    MulAgent
    Agent that multiplies the values of two input topics and publishes the product.
    Node
    A vertex in the computational Graph.
    ParallelAgent
    Decorator that wraps any Agent and executes its callbacks on a dedicated background thread (Active Object pattern).
    PlusAgent
    Agent that adds the values of two input topics and publishes the sum.
    PowerAgent
    Agent that raises a base value to an exponent and publishes the result.
    SqrtAgent
    Agent that computes the square root of a single input value and publishes the result.
    Topic
    A named publish-subscribe channel in the computational graph.
    TopicManagerSingleton
    Holder class that exposes the application-wide singleton TopicManagerSingleton.TopicManager.

    Thread-safe registry of all named Topic objects in the application.
